harness: on-device (ssh) numerical + perf verification for M-FLAT typed flat block-dot kernels

harness_files.reusable_for_next_flat_format: copy driver (change decode+quantize+symbol), reuse orchestrator (set TEST_MLIR / FRONT_DOOR_PASS / DRIVER / TARGETS)

kernel_under_test.family: M-FLAT q8_0 x q8_0 typed flat block-dot loop body
kernel_under_test.artifact: real exported RISC-V ELF relocatable object (front-door -> materialize-emission-plans -> tcrv-translate --tcrv-export-target-artifact)
kernel_under_test.abi_note: 8-role ggml strided vec_dot ABI plus a 9th reduce-seed pointer; emitted body consumes only n/s/vx/vy and uses a literal-0 reduce seed (zero_seed unused). Block = 34 bytes (fp16 scale + 32 int8). Integer core = one vle8_v_i8m2 x2 + vwmul_vv_i16m4 + vwredsum_vs per 32-elem block (m2 anchor).

numerical.reference: hand-written scalar q8_0 vec_dot with ggml's fold order; pure-integer IEEE fp16<->fp32 (NOT _Float16, which clang-17/rv64gcv-no-Zfh miscompiles on-board)
numerical.method: 256 independent random dot products, n=4096 (128 blocks), bit-for-bit compare of s[0]; two fold variants computed to empirically discover the kernel's contraction form
numerical.kernel_fold_form_discovered: fused-multiply-add (matches fmaf ref 256/256; non-contracted ref matches only 53/256, worst 80 ULP)
numerical.cross_board_result_bits_identical: 0x4286f2a1 on both VLEN128 and VLEN256 (m2-anchor reduction is VLEN-invariant for this data)

perf.framing: kernel MICROBENCH, not e2e decode; cross-machine numbers are NOT comparable (different cores/VLEN); baseline = same scalar reference compiled on-board (autovec at rv64gcv, pure-scalar at rv64gc)
perf.timing: clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW), best-of-7, 200000 iters, DCE defeated via memory-clobber barrier

k1.honest_finding: kernel LOSES to clang autovec on VLEN256: its fixed vsetvl_e8m2(32) m2-anchor under-fills the 256-bit vector (VLMAX_e8m2=64), while autovec uses the full width. The m2 anchor is VLEN128-tuned. Beats autovec on VLEN128 (1.43x).

infra_walls_hit_and_resolved: link: kernel .o needs soft fp16 builtins __extendhfsf2/__truncsfhf2; board default gcc-12 libgcc lacks them -> fixed with --rtlib=compiler-rt
reference fp16: _Float16 C type is miscompiled by clang-17 on rv64gcv without Zfh (every conversion wrong) -> replaced with pure-integer IEEE fp16<->fp32
perf DCE: pure loop-invariant scalar reference was hoisted (fake 4ns baseline) -> memory-clobber barrier per iteration
